title: Money without rounding errors
description:
Shops do not store prices as decimals, because `0.1 + 0.2` is not exactly `0.3`. They store whole **cents**.

Using the alias and struct provided, write:

- `Cents lineTotal(const Item& item)`: price × quantity.
- `std::string priceLabel(Cents amount)`: formats cents as dollars with two digits after the point, so `1205` becomes `"$12.05"` and `300` becomes `"$3.00"`.
- `std::string receiptLine(const Item& item)`: for example `"Coffee x3  $7.50"` (name, a space, `x` and the quantity, two spaces, the label of the line total).

For `priceLabel`: dollars are `amount / 100`, cents are `amount % 100`, and cents below 10 need a leading zero.
hints: Build `priceLabel` in pieces: `"$"`, the dollars as text, `"."`, an extra `"0"` if the cents are a single digit, then the cents as text.
